_note: Terminal XD segments for the TT Logger sheets whose Origin/Destination cells are place names ('Cascade, ID'), which reference.route_endpoints refuses to snap because a geocoded extent is a guess. These are operator input: the two end segments of each route, taken from the 2026-09 hand mapping that produced the original outside comparison (out/query_segment_mapping.json) and re-verified here by walking NextXDSegI between them and checking the resulting road names and mileage against the route. A route built this way carries whole end segments - no endpoint trim, no proration, no snap distance - and the report labels it so.
